Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Volume-tier proposal for stainless bar supply
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the alloy, labour and processing cost drivers. We appreciate your support from stock. For this business, please assess a dedicated volume tier rather than the quoted package.

Our proposed agreement covers a fixed annual volume of 94800 kg throughout a 24-month contract. The latest shared monthly forecast is attached; see the figures below for the supporting demand data. This gives you a concrete basis for planning the volume tier.

We propose EUR 4.58 per kg, with payment at 90 days net and no price adjustment clause, for the 24-month term. Please review these terms as a complete package and confirm the dedicated volume-tier price you can offer on that basis.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Thank you for the volume forecast; we are pleased to accept your request for a 24-month agreement and 90 days payment terms.
For a contract of this duration, we cannot offer a fixed price and must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage raw material volatility.
By applying the index clause, we can remove the long-term risk premium and offer a significantly reduced base price of €5.57 per kg.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.57 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bar supply – revised volume package
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for accepting the 24-month term and payment at 90 days net, and for taking the forecast into account. Those terms give us a useful basis for the agreement.

I understand your concern about raw-material volatility and the reason for including an AS-14404 clause. Your fixed-price material cover described in your letter does, however, provide some protection against that exposure. Please reconsider a fixed price for the agreed term on the committed volume basis.

Our purchase-order history also provides a concrete reference for the business already placed with you; see the figures below. Please take that trading history into account alongside the forecast when reviewing the volume-tier price.

We can improve our proposal to EUR 4.77 per kg, with payment at 90 days net, a 24-month contract and no price adjustment clause. Please review this revised package and let us know how far you can reduce your price on that basis.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.subject: Revised price proposal for stainless bar
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for reducing your offer and confirming payment at 90 days net over the 24-month term. I also appreciate your verification of our purchase-order history, even though you have not changed your calculation on that basis.

I understand that your material cover does not extend over the full agreement and that this is why you require an alloy index clause. Separately, the recent movement in PPI-C2431 warrants a review of the processing component of your price; see the figures below. Please take that movement into account alongside the annual volume already discussed.

We can raise our proposal to EUR 4.87 per kg, with payment at 90 days net, a 24-month contract and no price adjustment clause. This remains our proposed fixed-price package, rather than acceptance of the indexed offer. Please review the revised price and confirm what further reduction you can offer.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. We always strive to provide you with the best service from our extensive product range.

Regarding our cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We have verified the recent drop in the PPI-C2431 index and have adjusted our calculation to pass these processing cost savings on to you. However, as our fixed-price material cover only extends until March 2027, we cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month agreement and must maintain the AS-14404 index clause.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our current proposal stands at a price of €5.16 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.29 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that this Angebot is valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

strategy:
Supplier: Edelstahl-Service Donautal (stainless bar stockholder, group company, inside sales desk). Its letter of
2026-07-06 says its nickel/alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027. It always asks "Which volume
can you commit to?" and for the volume forecast; it will insert an AS-14404 index clause itself for a 24-month term
(let it - do not propose a clause yourself); it accepts 90-day payment when we hold it.
OBSERVED MECHANIC (4 sessions): its first reply is a package answer (about the same whatever our price). After that
it mirrors OUR price move: when we move up by 0.11-0.16 EUR it moves down by about 0.85 of that; when we move by 0.01-0.02
it moves 0.03-0.05 and declares a final offer. It also goes final when we change nothing. So: anchor deep in round 1,
then move UP by about 0.14 EUR every round on the SAME package (no clause, 90 days, 24 months) with one new
verified claim each round, never touching payment or term, until the code closes. Our asks should stay below its
price each round; if the gap gets below 0.12, move to about 0.02 under its price.
Plan: ROUND 1 - state the binding fixed annual volume (case volume per year and the total over 24 months), attach
the forecast (attachments: ["forecast"]) and cite fc-latest; ask for the dedicated volume tier price. ONE sheet:
no index clause, 90 days, 24 months, level L12 (deepest, about 4.55). ROUND 2 - thank it for what it accepted, cite the
purchase-order claim, move up ~0.14 (pick the level closest to last price + 0.14, same package: if it inserted an
index clause, keep OUR package without clause - the supplier may keep offering the clause; that is fine).
ROUND 3 - cite PPI-C2431 fall (first window), move up ~0.14. ROUND 4 - cite the second PPI-C2431 window, move up
~0.11. ROUND 5 - no new claim (do not re-cite PPI-C2431: one claim per index series), move up ~0.14, ask for its best price. Code accepts when it agrees or goes final.
Tone: warm, firm, concrete, short; one argument per sentence; mention its material cover until March 2027 once
(round 2) as the reason a fixed base price over the term is reasonable. Do NOT use any AS-14404 index claim and
do not use the scorecard claim.
